answer: Each seat binds to one ICAO 9303 ePassport chip and a 160 POA lock. Mid-epoch a kiosk sends H(epoch-seed || nonce); the chip must finish Active Authentication in 20s and chain to a published Country Signing CA. A second key with the same AA public-key hash, or a chip already seated, burns 80 POA and merges both claims. Only that hash and CSCA fingerprints are posted. I checked a SOD on a shale bench, let the audit wander to a second CSCA, and halted at the registry vertex of a colliding AA hash. Transcripts stay public for four epochs; leftover collateral refunds after three sealed answers.
